questions.question: Guess the player: 3878 runs in 133 innings (average 31.02, high score 193, 5 centuries) for Badgers / Warriors. (List A only career totals.)
Which of these unions has Tebogo Macheke actually played for?
questions.explanation: Tebogo Macheke has represented: Limpopo Lillies, Titans.

questions.question: In head-to-head T20 only meetings, who has the edge, Tuskers or Rhinos?
Who has achieved the 50+ runs and 4+ wickets in a match double more times, Marizanne Kapp or Alyssa Erxleben?
questions.explanation: Marizanne Kapp: 1 times. Alyssa Erxleben: 2 times.

questions.question: Iinyathi set a database record (15/16 season, T20 only) with a value of 162. Which record is it?
options: Lowest Team Total (all out or completed innings)
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Highest Team Total', held by Iinyathi.

questions.question: Marizanne Kapp became the all-time leading wicket-taker in Women's ODI World Cup history in 2025, surpassing which bowler's long-standing record of 43?
questions.explanation: Kapp took her 44th World Cup wicket during South Africa's 2025 semi-final win over England, surpassing India's Jhulan Goswami.
